notes.title: Update v1.5 is here!
notes.content:
Hello pikes !

We got a small update for you on this lovely spring day. We have added some birds in the environment: ducks, ospreys and eagles. You will see them on dead logs and trees, watching your every move, waiting for just the right moment to strike. Sounds for them are added as well!

We have also added a new How-To-Play panel during game creation to better underline the tutorial section and main goals of the game. Oh! And we have added the sound of a thousand angels chanting to your victory. You'll see when you get there. ;)

Changelog

Audio
- All environment 3D sounds have their minimum and maximum distance, spatial blend and volume rolloff modified to provide a better auditive experience
- Added a new song on the Victory screen

Environment
- Added ducks, eagles and ospreys to the three maps
- Removed some trees that were blocking the view

GUI
- Added a How-To-Play panel during the creation of a new game.

System
- The victory screen will now replace the game screen instead of loading additively to it.

notes.title: Released a small patch v1.4
notes.content:
Hello pikes!

First of all, thank you for your reviews and feedback. We love hearing from you and getting your suggestions to help us make Fish Simulator: Agonik Lake a better game.

Today, we are dropping a small update about the eagle's target timing. We've heard from some of you that the right timing to dodge the eagle is hard to get. The change also affects the fishermen targets. We hope this will help a bit!

Changelog

GUI
- The inner scaling circle of the Eagle and Fishermen targets are now white
- Added a counter above the Eagle target and inside the Fishermen target to help dodge at the right time

notes.title: Update v1.3 released!
notes.content:
Hello fellow pikes!

We got a small update for you today. The most important change is about the stamina regeneration. While we mean for stamina to be a resource you have to manage with care, we have increased the regeneration modifier by four. It should give more opportunities to use stamina in your play.

We also wanted to make the game easier by reducing the hit needed to eat the other big fishes. Be wary, it should still keep you on your fins. ;)

Changelog

Bugs

Fixed a bug where the player could pass through the terrain after a dodge.
Fixed a bug where the attack marker would be stuck over the player at the beginning of a game


System

 Added a text on the bottom left anchor of the main screen showing the current version of the game.
 The game over screen will now replace the game screen instead of loading additively to it. This is to avoid the situation where the game would still play when the game over screen is on.


Audio

 Reduced the player capture sound volume from 0.7 to 0.6.


Balance

 Reduced other pikes hit points from 8 to 5.
 Reduced Yellow Pickerels hit points from 3 to 2.
 Reduced Bass hit points from 5 to 3.
 Stamina regeneration speed is now 4 times faster going from 4 to 16.
